terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service (“Terms”) govern your use of Japanki, a Japanese-learning PWA. By using the service you agree to these Terms. Contact: japankiadm@gmail.com.

apply.title: 1. Scope
apply.body: These Terms apply to every use of Japanki, including guest (anonymous) sessions, linked Google or email accounts, quizzes, hearts, and paid content packs.

registration.title: 2. Accounts
registration.body: You may start as a guest, then link Google or email. Linking does not merge two existing accounts. We may refuse or revoke access for false information, abuse, or Terms violations.

fees.title: 3. Fees and payments
fees.body: The Survival pack is free. The Travel pack is a one-time paid digital pack (USD 2.99 unless shown otherwise at checkout). Payments are processed by Stripe. We do not store card numbers. Access is granted only after the Stripe webhook is verified—not by visiting the success page. Digital content is generally non-refundable except where required by law or caused by our fault.

prohibited.title: 4. Prohibited conduct
prohibited.body: You must not break the law; attack or scrape the service; reverse-engineer the app; cheat hearts, sessions, or purchases; impersonate others; or use Japanki in a way that harms other learners.

interruption.title: 5. Suspension
interruption.body: We may pause the service for maintenance, security, force majeure, or other reasons that make operation impractical, with or without prior notice.

copyright.title: 6. Intellectual property
copyright.body: Japanki phrases, design, software, and branding belong to the operator. Using the app does not transfer ownership of content to you.

disclaimer.title: 7. Disclaimer
disclaimer.body: Japanki is a lightweight learning aid. We do not guarantee fluency, pronunciation, or travel outcomes. When phrase audio files are missing, a Web Audio tone may play instead. We are not liable for device, network, or third-party (Supabase, Stripe, Vercel, Google) failures except where the law forbids such a limit.

changes.title: 8. Changes
changes.body: We may change or discontinue features. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised Terms.

governing.title: 9. Governing law
governing.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of Japan. If a dispute cannot be resolved, the courts of Japan have jurisdiction unless mandatory consumer law says otherwise.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Japanki handles personal data. Contact: japankiadm@gmail.com.

collect.title: 1. Information we collect
collect.body: If you link an account we collect your email and authentication identifiers. We also store quiz hearts, language preference, and purchase records (user id and pack id). Stripe handles card data; we do not store card numbers. Browsers may send technical data such as device type.

purpose.title: 2. Purpose
purpose.body: We use this information to run Japanki: authentication, hearts, unlocking paid packs after webhook verification, support, security, and service improvement.

sharing.title: 3. Sharing
sharing.body: We do not sell personal data. We share it only with your consent, when required by law, or with processors who help operate the service.

processors.title: 4. Processors
processors.body: Supabase (auth and database), Stripe (payments and customer portal), Vercel (hosting), and Google (OAuth if you choose Google sign-in). Each follows its own privacy policy. Japanki does not send quiz content to generative AI APIs.

retention.title: 5. Storage
retention.body: Data is stored with our processors using encrypted transport. Row Level Security limits users to their own profiles and purchases.

deletion.title: 6. Deletion
deletion.body: To delete your account and related data, email japankiadm@gmail.com. We will delete or anonymize records unless we must keep them for legal or fraud reasons.

children.title: 7. Children
children.body: Japanki is not directed at children under 13 (or the higher age required in your region). If you believe a child registered, contact us.

changes.title: 8. Changes
changes.body: We may update this policy. The date at the top will change. Continued use after an update constitutes acceptance.
